svg.aria-label: Two graphs below zero. (a) For d from 1/2 to pi over 4, the bound cos d/2 - 0.387 sin d - 11/40 of the separation of D and S along the secondary axis of D, largest, about -0.022, at d = 1/2. (b) For v from 0 to 5/8, the bound E of the separation along the secondary axis of S at d = 1/2 and at d = pi over 4, below the trigonometric bound at d = 1/2, dashed, and the quadratic bound, dotted, all negative
